summary: Steel fire watchtower on Porcupine Butte, Pine Ridge Indian Reservation; listed as standing, but its build date, builder and staffing are not in the sources found.

access.note: On the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation. No visiting rules were found in the sources; ask the tribe before going up.

corrections.why: Wikipedia places the butte in Oglala Lakota County; the South Dakota list still uses Shannon County.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The directory gives 3,691 feet (about 1,125 m, the value in the record); Wikipedia gives 3,665 feet (1,117 m). The record was not changed.
The directory uses Shannon County; Wikipedia uses Oglala Lakota County for the same butte.

notes_for_editor: Build date, builder, agency and staffing are unknown; two web searches found nothing on them. The directory and Wikipedia disagree on elevation and county name. Access level 'permission' follows from the reservation location; no visiting rules were found in the sources. The 1890 event is local context, not the tower's history, and the Wikipedia text cites Jack Utter's book, which was not read. Corrections: county is proposed for review only.
